company.name: Zeit AI
company.shortDescription: Zeit AI changes Excel files into a structured database that user can query using everyday language.
company.description: Zeit AI, founded by former Palantir engineers, generates a structured data base atop your tabular data files which you can query using natural language. For example, you suspect an efficiency in your organisation and you have a bunch of data files, instead of reading through all of them one by one in excel, you explore them in Zeit AI. They currently offer a two-week pilot program where their engineers develop tailored solutions for data challenges involving CSV, Excel, or PDF files.

productsAndServices.description: An AI-driven autonomous data engineer that connects systems, spreadsheets, and public sources to automate reports and answer business questions using natural language queries.
productsAndServices.name: ZeitMind
